data.name: Udhaya
data.gender_notes: Udhaya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Udhaya is derived from the Sanskrit root 'udh' meaning 'up', 'rise'. This name signifies the rising sun, the dawn, and the awakening of the spirit. It is a name that inspires courage, determination and new beginnings. The name Udhaya carries the meaning “Rising, Dawn, Awakening” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Udhaya usually hope their child will grow to embody rising, dawn, awakening and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Udhaya is a spiritual name that represents the divine energy of creation and the awakening of the inner self. It is a name that inspires growth, self-realization and the pursuit of enlightenment.
data.etymology: Udhaya belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rising, Dawn, Awakening.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Udhaya total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
